conversation.content: I enjoy reading science fiction novels.
Science fiction can be so immersive. Any favorite authors like Asimov or Heinlein?
I like to watch anime sometimes during the weekend.
Staying consistent with your anime habit. Have you watched any good shows recently?
I’m studying computer science.
Coding in your future. Which areas of CS interest you most, theory or practical applications?
I'm going to Paris next week for a vacation.
The City of Light awaits you. Don't forget to try a croissant or two!
I will start my new project next week, it's a web development project
Building something new. Will you be using any specific programming languages like JavaScript or Python?
My name is Alex and I prefer to be called Al.
Nice to meet you, Al.
I live in Milan, Italy, it's a beautiful city.
La Dolce Vita awaits you, Al.
I'm studying computer science and I love it.
Tech enthusiast, eh?
I work at a bakery downtown, I'm a pastry chef.
Sweet job, Al!
I'm saving money to travel to Japan next year.
Sushi and temples await you, Al.
I enjoy reading science fiction novels, especially Brandon Sanderson books.
Mistborn and Stormlight Archive, here you come, Al.
I like playing football every weekend with my friends.
Kicking goals and having fun, Al!
I love Italian food, especially pasta and risotto.
Carbs and love, a match made in Italy, Al!
